svg.text: EXPERIENCE: FROM A KILL TO A NEW LEVEL
below: drops go on its cell
adds the share to its own
hp and maxHp += one hit die
Experience a class slot must exceed to reach level n (ds:35BC tables)
The numbers agree with AD&D 2nd edition's [H]; the limit of 11 (cleric 10) is where each table ends in -1 [V]. A multi-class member levels each slot on its
own total, so a fighter/mage needs the share twice: 650 points of a kill among 4 living members are 162 each, 81 to each of his two classes.
